limits: All six historical 15.1 predecessors remain failed, without any 14.5 execution. Their missing case/publication/terminal/wait facts remain missing; source-specific documentation preserves each limitation.

The original admission regression created a second connector/original and changed publication after control-operation failure. Corrected source independently proves actual admission/cached-original denial on both pinned releases.
32 actual native-small originals and attempt-33/followup rejection pass on both releases. Projection-10,000 passes its complete 32-attempt procedure only on 15.1.

14.5 whole admission/capacity run fails at projection readiness after four complete/delivered originals and one complete/undelivered original. Actual producer-forward/store-failed diagnostic, five reaped connectors and guest/host teardown are retained. That case has no complete publication/case receipt. Exact forwarding-error/cancellation/deadline cause is not established and requires investigation without changing budgets.

Completed main cases retain five separately bounded immutable control frames. Captured attempts, actual source request IDs and observed publication metadata remain separate; unobserved background publications are not invented.

Normal handoff uses the original absolute 45-second collection deadline; initial bootstrap and corrected negative-artifact control keep ten-second bounds. Closing the parent inherited-end duplicate fixes observed EOF delay. Timely artifact refusal requires exit 1, actual refusal output, no context expiry/overflow and original usage.
Fresh same-source connector interruption and ancillary rejection/census matrices pass on both releases. These component controls do not establish whole native/resource/release acceptance.

Native-small uses the existing small disposable ZFS/md topology and actual guest filesystem census, not the full 100-owned-dataset resource workload. Projection uses the existing separate deterministic emitter. Product artifacts/public APIs/configuration, runtime dependencies and services are unchanged.

Full broker raw/archive/physical/overlap controls, remaining cancellation/recovery, historical 14.5 sampling gaps, cadence/overhead/augmented budgets, 300-second idle, original large latency and full resource/browser/manual accessibility/hardware/release gates remain open.

Canonical resource runner stays inactive; runtime writes stay denied. Untimed diagnostics are not workload control/coalescing or cadence acceptance. Developer-controlled evidence requires maintainer review and is not external attestation.
